subject: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows
parts:
Hello there! I have been running into problems trying to create an unmarkedMultFrame. I keep getting the error message: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows, when I try to create the UMF. I would appreciate any help, as I am fairly new to R and have tried several options (list(), as.vector(), etc.) outlined in previous posts. Thank you - Sean.

My code:

#EH Data
y <- FosnEH[,2:15] #Detection History
n <- nrow(FosnEH) #Number of Sites
J <- 7 #Number of Site Visits per Site (secondary sampling occasions)
T <- 2 #Number of Years (primary sampling occasions)

#Year Effects
years.cov <- data.frame(matrix(rep(2016:2017, each = n), n, T))
years.cov <- data.frame(lapply(years.cov, as.factor))

#Site Covariates
site.alias <- data.frame(site.alias=FosnEH[,1]) #Site
site.region <- data.frame(site.region=FosnEH[,16]) #Region
site.elev <- data.frame(site.elev=FosnEH[,17]) #Elevation

#Combine Site Covarites
site.covs <- data.frame(c(site.alias,site.region,site.elev))

#Observation Covariates
obs.visit <- data.frame(FosnEH[,18:31]) #Site Visit Number
obs.dayscore <- data.frame(FosnEH[,32:45]) #Dayscore of Visit

#Combine Obs covariates
obs.covs <- data.frame(c(obs.visit,obs.dayscore))

#Create UMF
FosnUMF <- unmarkedMultFrame(y = y, siteCovs = site.covs, obsCovs = obs.covs, numPrimary = 2, yearlySiteCovs = years.cov)

Error in validObject(.Object) : 
  invalid class “unmarkedFrame” object: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows.

messages.author: 67eefb0e32c64fae
messages.subject: Re: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows
parts:
I believe I have fixed the problem... obsCovs requires a list of covariates, not a data.frame... Could someone please confirm this, as I'm scared R is playin me for a fool!

Corrected code:
...

#Observation Covariates
obs.visit <- data.frame(FosnEH[,18:31]) #Site Visit Number (issue)

#Create UMF (also combines obs.Covs)
FosnUMF <- unmarkedMultFrame(y = y, siteCovs = site.covs, obsCovs = list(obs.visit=obs.visit,obs.dayscore=obs.dayscore), numPrimary = 2, yearlySiteCovs = years.cov)

messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] Re: obsCovData does not have M*obsNum rows
parts:
yea I think that's right.  I believe also that a dataframe can be used but the structure is confusing:
. obsCovs is a data frame with MTJ rows, which are ordered by site-year-observation, so that a column of obsCovs corresponds to as.vector(t(y)), element-by-element.
I guess no one understands that (I know I don't!) so I recommend using the list.

I suppose the help file could use some editing... I will add that to my "todo when I retire" list.
regards,
andy
